rules.rule: Interest corrections may be credited only when interest was calculated wrongly (missing boost, wrong tier, missing relationship bonus). The credit_type must be 'interest_correction' and the amount must be greater than 0.
rules.quote: credit_type (string): Must be one of 'interest_correction', 'fee_refund', or 'goodwill_credit'

rules.rule: Apply the credit first and submit the discrepancy report only after it
rules.quote: Important: Always apply the credit to the customer's account BEFORE submitting the report.

rules.rule: Expected APY is the sum of all applicable components: base, tier, linked checking boost, credit card bonus and relationship bonus
rules.quote: 4) Review documentation for the savings account type to determine all applicable APY components (base rate, tier rate, linked checking boost, credit card bonuses, relationship bonus)

rules.rule: The Gold Account (savings) base APY is 5.5%, not any other figure the customer assumes
rules.quote: Your account earns an APY of 5.5% on the balance you maintain.

rules.rule: Green Account (checking) + Gold Account (savings) is a qualifying pairing
The Green checking boost on a linked Gold savings account is +0.75% (not 1.0%)
rules.quote: Boost a linked savings account's APY: Gold +0.75% or Silver +0.25%

rules.rule: Only pairings on the list earn a linked checking boost. The boost adds to the base APY and the credit card bonuses.
rules.quote: The boost is additive to your savings account's base APY and any credit card APY bonuses you may already have.

rules.rule: If the customer has several checking accounts, only the highest checking boost applies
rules.quote: Only the HIGHEST checking account APY boost is applied to the savings account.

rules.rule: Gold Account credit card bonuses: Bronze Rewards +0.15%, Silver Rewards +0.2%, Gold Rewards +0.025%, Platinum Rewards +0.15%, Diamond Elite +0.3%, EcoCard +0.6%, Green Rewards +0.35%, Crypto-Cash Back +0%
Credit card bonuses do not stack. Only the single highest card bonus applies.
rules.quote: Only the highest applicable credit card APY bonus is applied to the customer's savings account.

rules.rule: Credit card bonuses do stack with checking boosts and relationship bonuses
rules.quote: However, credit card APY bonuses DO stack with other types of bonuses, such as:

rules.rule: A Gold Account holder who also holds a Gold Rewards Card gets a 0.025% relationship bonus added to the base APY
rules.quote: As a Gold Rewards Card holder, you receive an additional 0.025% relationship bonus APY on top of the base rate.

rules.rule: Report APYs as percent numbers (e.g. 2.775 for 2.775%)
rules.quote: expected_apy (number): The APY percentage the customer should have received (e.g., 2.775 for 2.775%)

jobs.done_when: The customer is verified and logged. The expected APY has been calculated from the documents and the customer's wrong assumptions corrected. If the customer agreed, the interest difference has been credited with apply_savings_account_credit_6831 (interest_correction), and after that submit_interest_discrepancy_report_7294 has been filed. The customer has been told the credit, the new balance and that the report was submitted.

open_questions: No document gives the formula for monthly interest. The workflow assumes monthly interest = balance × APY ÷ 12 and actual APY = credited interest × 12 ÷ balance.

Gold Rewards Card's 0.025% appears both as a credit card bonus (gold_account_014, and the example in 045) and as a separate 'relationship bonus' (gold_account_013). The workflow adds it as a relationship bonus on top of the highest card bonus, e.g. 5.5 + 0.75 (Green) + 0.6 (EcoCard) + 0.025 = 6.875%. If it is only a card bonus, the total would be 6.85%.
gold_account_013's example says 5.5% + 0.025% = '6.0%', which is an arithmetic error in the document. Use the sum of the components.
